Open to conversations/ Structural design engineer/ RC buildings

I design concrete structures, then detail them ready to build.

Hi, I'm Fahdil. I design the reinforced concrete frames that buildings stand on: beams, columns, slabs, pad foundations and staircases, from the architect's drawings to the reinforcement details on site.

I model and analyse in ProtaStructure, design to BS 8110-1997 and draw the details in AutoCAD. On my featured project, a triplex residential building, I designed the first and second floor slabs myself and assisted on the rest. I graduated in Civil Engineering (B.Tech, LAUTECH, 2024), so I check everything before I trust it.
